name: Finishing Well
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of persevering faithfully to the end of the Christian journey, valuing the completion of our course over mere beginnings, as Ecclesiastes highlights the greater worth of the end and a patient spirit. Luke teaches the necessity of careful planning and commitment to finish what we start, while Paul exemplifies this in Acts by prioritizing finishing his ministry with joy despite hardships. Galatians encourages believers not to grow weary in doing good, promising a harvest if they endure, and Philippians assures us that God who began His work in us will faithfully bring it to completion until Christ's return. The pursuit of maturity and full understanding in Christ, as Paul expresses in Philippians, calls for continual effort and reliance on Christ’s sustaining grace.
